desc:
!! THIS GAME IS IN BETA, EXPECT BUGS !!

🏙️ Brickline is a city simulation game where you build your own city from the ground up and become the greatest mayor in history...or the worst. Tax the rich, spoil the poor, rig an election or two.

🛣️ Build streets and great highways
🏠 Zone homes, shops and industry that grow on their own
🚓 Manage police, fire, healthcare and schools
🚆 Connect your city with buses, trains and a metro
🎓 Educate your people and grow your workforce
📜 Pass policies that win over some citizens and anger others
🐦 Hear what your city thinks of you on Coo
🏛️ Unlock landmarks and milestones
🗳️ Campaign and win the election
🏆 Climb the leaderboards to become the greatest city



Inspired by classic city builders.
